title: taraxacum taraxacum var. alpinum
intro: Taraxacum taraxacum var. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Dandelion, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and support liver function. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Dandelion include its potential to stimulate the production of bile, improve appetite, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
